Hi Pensacola SEO Company - Christopher Simpson,

I ran a free automated audit on https://pensacolaseocompany.com and wanted to share the results with you.

69/100
Grade: D

Here's what I found:

  • ❌ 🔒 Security: Clickjacking Protection — X-Frame-Options not set
  • ❌ 🔒 Security: XSS Protection — X-XSS-Protection not set
  • ⚠️ 🔒 Security: HSTS — Strict-Transport-Security present but may be misconfigured
  • ❌ ⚡ Performance: Browser Caching — No cache headers
  • ❌ ⚡ Performance: Viewport Meta — No viewport meta tag
  • ⚠️ ⚡ Performance: Resource Hints — No preconnect/preload hints
  • ⚠️ ♿ Accessibility: Heading Hierarchy — 4 skipped heading levels
  • ⚠️ 🍪 Cookies & Privacy: GDPR Compliance — Partial GDPR: privacy

Here's what I'd prioritize:

  1. Fix: X-Frame-Options not set
  2. Fix: X-XSS-Protection not set
  3. Fix: No cache headers
  4. Fix: No viewport meta tag
